main{width:1280px;height:720px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;position:relative;padding:64px 72px 0;box-sizing:border-box}.sub,.band p,.lv,section,h1{margin:0}section[data-role=section]{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px solid var(--ink);padding-top:10px}h1{font-size:52px;font-weight:700;margin-top:22px;line-height:1.25}.sub{font-size:28px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}.bands{margin-top:38px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px}.band{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:28px}.tag{width:220px;flex:none;position:relative}.lv{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;display:block;padding-top:10px}.bar{display:block;height:8px;margin-top:10px;width:220px}.b0 .bar{background:var(--accent)}.b1 .bar{background:var(--ink);width:150px}.b2 .bar{background:var(--muted);width:90px}.b0 .lv{color:var(--ink)}.b1 .lv{color:var(--ink)}.b2 .lv{color:var(--muted)}.band p{font-size:28px;line-height:1.55;white-space:pre-line;max-width:880px;border-left:1px solid var(--ink);padding-left:28px}.b2 p{border-left-color:var(--muted)}
main{padding:0}section[data-role=section]{position:absolute;left:64px;top:42px;padding:0;border:0;line-height:24px;letter-spacing:4px}h1{position:absolute;left:64px;top:88px;font-size:46px;margin:0;line-height:1.28}.sub{position:absolute;left:64px;top:164px;margin:0;line-height:1.4}.bands{position:absolute;left:64px;top:242px;width:1152px;margin:0;gap:24px}.b0 .bar,.b1 .bar,.b2 .bar{width:200px;height:4px}.tag{width:228px}.band p{line-height:1.45}.lv{font-size:30px}
